def test_a_requirement_shows_its_acceptance_lines_once(self):
        r = self.root
        spec = r / "pdlc/specs/capabilities/CAP-greeting.md"
        spec.write_text(spec.read_text().replace(
            "Says hola.\n", 'Says hola.\n\n- Given lang es, when greeting Ana, then the text is "Hola, Ana!"\n'))
        git(r, "add", "-A"); git(r, "commit", "-qm", "lines")
        make_packets.main(["x", "CH-0001"], root=self.root)
        for remit in ["tests", "specification", "security"]:
            text = self.packet(remit)
            self.assertEqual(text.count("Given lang es"), 1)
            self.assertIn("Says hola.", text)
            self.assertIn("acceptance lines of this requirement are in the change spec above", text)

    def test_a_requirement_keeps_a_line_that_the_change_spec_lacks(self):
        r = self.root
        spec = r / "pdlc/specs/capabilities/CAP-greeting.md"
        spec.write_text(spec.read_text().replace(
            "Says hola.\n", 'Says hola.\n\n- Given lang es, when greeting Ana, then the text is "Hola, Ana!"\n'
            '- Given lang fr, when greeting Ana, then the text is "Salut, Ana!"\n'))
        git(r, "add", "-A"); git(r, "commit", "-qm", "lines")
        make_packets.main(["x", "CH-0001", "tests"], root=self.root)
        text = self.packet("tests")
        self.assertEqual(text.count("Given lang es"), 2)
        self.assertIn("Given lang fr", text)

    def test_a_new_file_appears_once_as_its_full_text(self):
        r = self.root
        (r / "test/new.test.js").write_text("test('CAP-greeting.R2 adios', () => {}) // SECRET-NEW\n")
        change = self.folder / "change.md"
        change.write_text(change.read_text().replace("- test/greet.test.js", "- test/greet.test.js\n- test/new.test.js"))
        git(r, "add", "-A"); git(r, "commit", "-qm", "new check file")
        make_packets.main(["x", "CH-0001", "tests"], root=self.root)
        text = self.packet("tests")
        self.assertEqual(text.count("SECRET-NEW"), 1)
        self.assertIn("### test/new.test.js (new file)", text)
        self.assertIn("### Diff against main", text)
        self.assertEqual(text.count("SECRET-TEST"), 2)

    def test_only_the_tests_packet_has_the_check_tagging_rules(self):
        r = self.root
        (r / "pdlc/specs/design/DES-pdlc-check-tagging.md").write_text("# DES-pdlc-check-tagging\nCHECK-NAMES rule.\n")
        change = self.folder / "change.md"
        change.write_text(change.read_text().replace("- DES-writing-style", "- DES-writing-style\n- DES-pdlc-check-tagging"))
        git(r, "add", "-A"); git(r, "commit", "-qm", "relies")
        make_packets.main(["x", "CH-0001"], root=self.root)
        self.assertIn("CHECK-NAMES", self.packet("tests"))
        self.assertNotIn("CHECK-NAMES", self.packet("specification"))
        self.assertNotIn("CHECK-NAMES", self.packet("security"))
